QUOTE: "The library itself (`library/`) has no spawn sites." and "`mbedtls_mutex_init/lock/unlock/free` are function pointers (`include/mbedtls/threading.h:105–161`), defaulting to the pthread implementation in `threading.c`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that library/ has no thread spawn sites and that library/threading.c supplies the mutex abstraction (init/lock/unlock/free) used when threading is enabled.
